metadata.description: Sports business news sources for global benchmarking audit

sources.name: SportsPro Media
sources.why: Industry-leading outlet for sports business deals, sponsorship activations, and market-entry coverage. Frequently reports on rights-holder expansion into emerging markets.

sources.name: SportBusiness
sources.why: Premium sports business intelligence. Covers commercial deals, event strategies, and international expansion across F1, football, NBA, and NFL.

sources.name: Front Office Sports
sources.why: Strong coverage of US league (NBA/NFL) international business strategy, media rights, and grassroots activations. Good for tracking American sports' global push.

sources.name: Inside World Football
sources.why: Covers FIFA, UEFA, and top club commercial operations globally. Excellent for tracking European football clubs' marketing activations in Asia and Middle East.

sources.name: Arabian Business – Sport
sources.why: Regional lens on KSA/UAE sports investments and activations. Captures on-the-ground marketing events, VIP hospitality, and grassroots clinics that global outlets miss.

sources.name: LaLiga News (Official)
sources.why: Official LaLiga news feed covers international expansion, fan events, grassroots clinics, and commercial activations in target markets. Essential for tracking La Liga's push into India, KSA, Japan, and UAE.
